ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM #10B): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the Board if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 5/21/14 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2014-06-11 Item 08A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2014-06-11 Item 08B - Warrants
8C.
Licensing agreement between the City of Encinitas and Boys and Girls Clubs of San Dieguito, Griset Branch, for use of Oakcrest Park southern parking lot. Contact Person: Park and Beach Superintendent Frenken
Approve the license agreement between the City of Encinitas and Boys and Girls Clubs of San Dieguito, Griset Branch, for use of Oakcrest Park southern parking lot.
2014-06-11 Item 08C - Boys and Girls Club Parking Lot
8D.
Participation in the Figtree Financing Property Assessed Clean Energy (PACE) Program. Contact Person: Deputy City Manager Phillips
1) Adopt Resolution 2014-29 approving Associate Membership by the City of Encinitas, California in the California Enterprise Development Authority and authorizing and directing the execution of an Associate Membership agreement relating to Associate Membership of the City in the Authority and 2) Adopt Resolution 2014-30 consenting to inclusion of properties within the incorporated area of the City of Encinitas in the San Diego County Property Assessed Clean Energy (PACE) program administered by Figtree Financing to finance distributed generation renewable energy sources and energy and water efficiency improvements, approving the report setting forth the parameters of the program and certain matters in connection therewith.
2014-06-11 Item 08D - Participation in the Figtree PACE Program
8E.
Participation in the HERO Property Assessed Clean Energy (PACE) Program. Contact Person: Deputy City Manager Phillips
Adopt Resolution 2014-31 consenting to the inclusion of properties within the City's Jurisdiction in the California HERO Program to finance distributed generation renewable energy sources, energy and water efficiency improvements and electric vehicle charging infrastructure and approving the amendment to a certain joint powers agreement related thereto.
2014-06-11 Item 08E - Participation in the HERO PACE Program
8F.
Adoption of Resolution No. 2014-39, calling a General Municipal Election to be held Tuesday, November 4, 2014, and adoption of Resolution No. 2014-40, requesting the County Board of Supervisors to consolidate the City's General Municipal Election with the Statewide General Election. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
1) Adopt Resolutions 2014-39 and 2014-40; and 2) Direct the City Attorney to prepare an impartial analysis of the qualified measure appearing on the ballot.
2014-06-11 Item 08F - Calling the Election
8G.
Renewal of the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Ruess
1) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014-22, resolution of intention to order the renewal of the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District for FY 2014-15; and 2) Set the public hearing for June 25, 2014.
2014-06-11 Item 08G - ELLD Resolution 2014-22
8H.
Award of construction contract for the Santa Fe Drive North Sidewalk Improvements Project, CS07B. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Keller
1) Approve a contract with Blue Pacific Engineering and Construction in the amount of $465,904.00 for the construction of the Santa Fe Dr. North Sidewalk Improvements project, a HSIP project; and
2) Authorize augmentation of the existing contract with Excel Landscape, Inc. in the amount of $90,000.00 for landscape and irrigation improvements; and
3) Authorize the Director of Engineering and Public Works to award contracts for construction specialists, inspections, and other contracts, including construction staking, traffic engineering and inspection, geotechnical services, materials testing, purchase of landscape materials, engineering inspection, construction of those project elements not covered by the HSIP grant, and contingencies as necessary to complete the project, with a total not-to-exceed cost for the project of $835,043.00.
2014-06-11 Item 08H - Santa Fe Dr Sidewalk
8I.
Award of construction contract for the Santa Fe Drive Undergrounding District 17 Project, CS07B. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Keller
1) Approve a contract with Blue Pacific Engineering and Construction in the amount of $914,277.90 for the construction of the Santa Fe Dr. Undergrounding District 17 project, a HSIP project; and 2) Authorize the Director of Engineering and Public Works to award contracts for construction specialists, inspections, and other contracts, including construction staking, geotechnical services, materials testing, engineering inspection, and contingencies as necessary to complete the project, with a total not-to-exceed construction cost for the project of $1,200,000.00.
2014-06-11 Item 08I - Santa Fe Dr Undergrounding
8J.
Adoption of Ordinance No. 2014-05 amending Municipal Code Section 2.20 regarding duties and salary for the elected Mayor, Deputy Mayor and Council Members. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adoption of Ordinance No. 2014-05 entitled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas Amending Encinitas Municipal Code Section 2.20 Regarding Duties and Salary for Elected Mayor, Deputy Mayor and Council Members."
2014-06-11 Item 08J - Adoption of Ordinance 2014-05 Duties and Salary - Mayor, Depty Mayor & Council
8K.
Application to the Federal Edward Byrne Memorial Justice Assistance Grant (JAG) Program FY2014 Local Solicitation. Contact Person: Executive Assistant Zenns
This report is being presented as an informational report for review of the grant application and allocation plan for the Edward Byrne Memorial Justice Assistance Grant (JAG) Program FY2014 Local Solicitation.
2014-06-11 Item 08K - JAG Grant Application
8L.
Adoption of Ordinance No. 2014-04, amending Municipal Code Chapter 23.94, regarding traffic mitigation fees. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Deane
Adopt Ordinance No. 2014-04, entitled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 23.94 regarding Traffic Mitigation Fees."
2014-06-11 Item 08L - Adoption of Ordinance 2014-04 Traffic Mitigatin Fees
9.

10A.
Approval of Fiscal Year 2014-15 Operating Budget ("Second Year Revise") and Capital Improvement Program with Appropriations for FY2014-15 and FY2015-16 and adoption of Resolution No. 2014-42; Determination of Appropriation Limit for FY2014-15 and adoption of Resolution No. 2014-43; and approval of Position Titles and Pay Ranges for FY2014-15 and Adoption of Resolution No. 2014-45. Contact Person: Finance Manager Shoemaker
Staff recommends that Council adopt Resolution No. 2014-42, approving the FY2014-15 Operating Budget and FY2014-15 and FY2015-16 Capital Improvement Program Appropriations, adopt Resolution No. 2014-43, determining the FY2014-15 Appropriation Limit and adopt Resolution No. 2014-45 approving Position Titles and Pay Ranges for FY2014-15.
2014-06-11 Item 10A - FY 2014-15 Budget Adoption
10B.
Public Hearing of an Appeal filed by Pierre Joubert regarding the Planning Commission's approval of a Design Review Permit to add new parking spaces, construction of retaining walls that vary between 6 feet and 14 feet tall, and site and landscaping improvements for an existing office/commercial center. The project site is zoned General Commercial (GC) in the New Encinitas community. The appellant is appealing the Planning Commission's decision to "increase the parking lot size" and "reduce the size of the slope" as approved by Planning Commission Resolution No. 2014-05 on March 6, 2014. The appellant asserts that the additional parking is unnecessary and would destabilize the slope adjacent to several residential lots. CASE NUMBER: 13-038 ADR; APPLICANT: North El Camino Real, LLC; LOCATION: 285 North El Camino Real (APNs: 257-062-26 and -29) Contact Person: Associate Planner Dichoso
Deny the appeal, affirm the decision of the Planning Commission to approve the design of new parking spaces, retaining walls that vary between 6 feet and 14 feet tall, and site and landscaping improvements for an existing office/commercial center, and adopt Resolution of Approval 2014-41.
2014-06-11 Item 10B - Appeal Case# 13-038 ADR Parking Lot Appeal
10C.
Public Hearing for the presentation and discussion of the Draft Invasive Plant Policy by the Invasive & Toxic Plant Subcommittee. Contact Person: Associate Planner Winter
THIS ITEM HAS BEEN RESCHEDULED TO JULY 16, 2014.
10D.
Parks and Recreation Commission work plans for FY 2013-14 and FY 2014-15. Contact Person: Recreation Superintendent Gorham
1) Receive an oral report regarding the FY 2013-14 Parks and Recreation Commission work plan; and 2) Approve the proposed FY 2014-15 Parks and Recreation Commission work plan.
2014-06-11 Item 10D - P&R Commission Work Plan
10E.
Review of the Interstate-5 Widening Project - comment letter to the California Coastal Commission. Contact Person: Associate Planner Strong
Receive report, provide direction to staff as appropriate, and authorize the Mayor to issue a comment letter regarding the North Coast Corridor Project.
2014-06-11 Item 10E - Interstate 5 Widening Project Comment Letter

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
